tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the swap card, menus.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and every 2px outline; text on paper, paper-raised, zec-soft and the soft status fills.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and metadata, on paper and paper-raised (7:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The 2px outline on cards, inputs, chips and the secondary button. An alias of ink: outlines are always full-strength.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside a card, never an outline.

tokens.name: zec
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view, the current timeline step, the cover. Fill only; as text use zec-text.

tokens.name: on-zec
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a zec fill (10:1).

tokens.name: zec-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background: the shielded-balance pill, the Locked and Waiting chips.

tokens.name: zec-text
tokens.usage: Yellow-family text accent on paper and paper-raised (6.3:1 light, 10:1 dark).

tokens.name: final
tokens.usage: Final and done: chip text and the done timeline dot; as text, on paper and final-soft.

tokens.name: final-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Final chip and success notices.

tokens.name: refund
tokens.usage: Refunding and returned funds: a safe outcome, so blue, never red; as text, on paper and refund-soft.

tokens.name: refund-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Refunding chip and refund notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Action needed: a missed liveness window, an error. As text, on paper and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger chips and notices.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 3px, 2px offset; 3:1 or more on every surface.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Archivo at two weights: 800 for anything you should read from across a room, 400 for everything else.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in the swap card. Always tabular numerals.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Waiting for the lock to be final
styles.usage: Card and section titles, the current step.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your ZEC is safe at every step.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a value and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gaps in a row of chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, timeline row gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, hash chips, small blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, notices, the swap card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status chips, the balance pill.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Every outline: cards, chips, inputs, the secondary button.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: The current timeline step's ring and the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: The swap card only: the one object on the screen that holds money.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Primary button at rest; drops to none when pressed.
